en:
## New Features

- Git changes support task-based changelists, file and hunk ownership, paginated views, subscriptions and an offline CLI. Expanded views and pagination survive refreshes and reconnects.
- Reasoning translations load on visible demand, appear alongside the original text and update during streaming, including sealed summaries and merged reasoning cards.
- MCP supports OAuth authorization and sign-out for remote servers, client settings, richer content blocks and structured-only results. Tool-call progress appears on generic tool progress bars.
- Provider setup uses backend service templates, endpoint identification and source-group views. Model listings follow the selected template; credentials share a unified store and transfer format, and quota snapshots are tracked per credential.
- Background tasks have running/finished sections, search and kind filters. Watch has its own expandable result row, and target cards show their tool calls and watches.
- Pending plan approval cards can request an on-demand reflection review, with permission checks before applying its conclusion.
- Sessions have a fast-mode setting. File lists gain context-menu operations, and background tasks, services and browsers can be created manually.
- Ask-in-passing conversations are child sessions of the main conversation. iOS status-bar taps scroll the active view to the top.
- Optional unattended shutdown waits for all narrators to become idle, with cancellation and a final idle-state check.
- Model tracing adds offline lm-detector scoring. Administrators can capture a bounded CPU profile without restarting the service.

## Performance and Reliability

- Move many SQLite reads into bounded Workers: authentication, session lists and details, message history, tool output, knowledge, search, file evidence, recovery and background runtime metadata. Add queue/SQL diagnostics and startup readiness gates to keep heavy reads off the server thread.
- Improve large transcript rendering, preserve live tool output across history-window replacement and restore progress when opening a running session.
- Stabilize startup, shutdown and recovery ownership; drain checkpoint and maintenance work and recover reader readiness after transient failures.
- Deduplicate repeated Watch observations while preserving each watch's result, and keep subagent runs open while their wake-producing work is pending.

## Fixes and Changes

- Local sessions no longer record file history; reverting defaults to messages only. Whole-tree snapshots are no longer captured, while local file-tree refresh remains available.
- Fix subagent follow-parent model selection, startup-failure settlement, archive state and ownerless takeover holds.
- Fix queued-message editing so the original text is not consumed before editing finishes; repair long inline Show more buttons and Markdown images in virtual lists.
- Harden MCP OAuth consent, scope discovery, callback paths, secret identity and revocation boundaries; configured headers cannot override protocol headers or leak to other origins.
- Keep provider secrets across schema changes, preserve image settings through protocol overrides and support tool-result images in Chat Completions. Responses sends cacheable developer input, and Codex usage is charged to the account that served the request.
- Improve cached sign-in recovery, WebSocket reconnects after resume and PWA shell/cache recovery. start:dev serves rebuilt frontend assets without restarting the backend.
- Preserve Git authorization boundaries and retained views, support complete listings with many worktrees, and harden file rename/paste operations and cleanup recovery.
- Update-server mirrors sync patches and metadata by default; full binaries remain opt-in. CI can accelerate public patch downloads, and WebDAV transfers support longer bounded uploads. Server-side relay asset pulls now default to eight concurrent transfers (configurable from 1 to 8), retaining hash verification, cancellation and atomic publication.
- Fix invitation, project-membership, knowledge-version and PostgreSQL compatibility edge cases, and reduce timing races in regression tests.
- Restore lifecycle watches after restart using the original registrant's identity, preserving extended deadlines and exact handles.

## Upgrade Notes

- This beta / prerelease uses executor 0.9.8 for the updated remote Git workspace operations; the executor protocol remains version 1. The optional remote-peer component moves to 0.2.0-alpha.3 for updated Go dependencies, retaining protocol version 2. Startup applies the included database migrations automatically.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- Git 变更支持按任务分组、文件与修改块归属、分页视图、订阅和离线 CLI；刷新或重连后保留展开状态和分页进度。
- 思考过程按可见区域按需翻译，与原文并列展示；流式输出、已封存摘要和合并思考卡片也能更新翻译。
- 远程 MCP 支持 OAuth 授权、退出登录和客户端配置，兼容更丰富的内容块与纯结构化结果；工具调用进度接入通用进度条。
- 供应商配置采用后端服务模板，支持端点识别与来源分组；模型列表跟随模板，凭据统一存储和导入导出，额度快照按凭据分别记录。
- 后台任务区分运行中与已完成，支持搜索和类型筛选；Watch 有独立且可展开的结果行，目标卡片展示关联工具调用和观察。
- 挂起中的计划审批卡可按需发起反思审查，并在结论生效前复查操作权限。
- 新增会话级快速模式；文件列表增加右键操作，并可手动创建后台任务、服务和浏览器。
- 顺便提问改为主会话的子会话；iOS 点击状态栏可将当前视图滚到顶部。
- 可选无人值守关机：等待所有叙述者空闲，支持取消，并在关机前再次核对空闲状态。
- 模型追踪接入 lm-detector 离线评分；管理员可在不重启服务的情况下采集有时限的 CPU profile。

## 性能与稳定性

- 大量 SQLite 读取迁入有界 Worker：涵盖鉴权、会话列表与详情、消息历史、工具输出、知识库、搜索、文件证据、恢复和后台运行时元数据；增加排队与 SQL 诊断、启动就绪门禁，减少服务主线程阻塞。
- 优化长对话渲染，历史窗口替换时保留工具实时输出，重新打开运行中会话时恢复进度。
- 加固启动、关停与恢复期间的资源归属，排空检查点和维护任务，并在瞬态故障后恢复读取通道就绪状态。
- 重复 Watch 合并观察但保留各自结果；子代理发起的唤醒型工作尚未完成时，保持其运行等待结果。

## 修复与调整

- 本地会话不再记录文件历史，回退默认仅处理消息；整树快照不再抓取，本地文件树仍可正常刷新。
- 修复子代理跟随父会话的模型选择、启动失败收尾、归档状态和无主运行的接管阻塞。
- 编辑排队消息时暂停消费，避免原文提前发送；修复长行内 Show more 按钮和虚拟列表中的 Markdown 图片。
- 加固 MCP OAuth 同意流程、scope 发现、回调路径、凭据身份与撤权边界；自定义请求头不再覆盖协议头或泄漏到其他来源。
- 供应商 schema 变化时保留密钥，协议覆盖时保留图片设置，Chat Completions 支持工具结果图片；Responses 使用可缓存的 developer 输入，Codex 请求计费归于实际服务账号。
- 改善缓存登录身份恢复、设备唤醒后的 WebSocket 重连和 PWA 页面／缓存恢复；start:dev 无需重启后端即可提供重新构建的前端。
- 保留 Git 授权边界与已有视图，支持大量 worktree 的完整清单，并加固文件重命名、粘贴和清理恢复。
- 更新服务器镜像默认同步补丁与元数据，全量包保持显式选择；CI 可加速公开补丁下载，WebDAV 传输支持更长的有界上传；服务器中转资产拉取默认 8 路并发（可配置 1–8），保留摘要校验、取消和原子发布。
- 修复邀请、项目成员批量操作、知识库版本核对和 PostgreSQL 兼容边界，减少回归测试中的时序竞争。
- 生命周期 Watch 可在重启后按原注册者身份恢复，保留延长后的期限和精确句柄。

## 升级说明

- 本版本属于 beta／预发布通道，使用 executor 0.9.8 提供更新后的远程 Git 工作区操作，执行器协议仍为版本 1；可选 remote-peer 因 Go 依赖更新升级为 0.2.0-alpha.3，协议仍为版本 2。所含数据库迁移在启动时自动执行。
